# asimogg.io

> AI automations that actually do the work. One builder designs, builds and ships AI automations that run in production inside real businesses — quotes, follow-ups, reports, order flows, internal assistants. Bilingual site (English / Turkish). Not an agency, not a course.

## What this site offers
- Quote & document automation: incoming requests become priced quotes, contracts and invoices.
- Follow-up agents: leads, unpaid invoices and idle customers followed up on time, in the client's own tone.
- Reporting pipelines: data scattered across Excel, ERP and e-commerce lands on one live view every morning.
- Internal AI assistants: procedures, price lists and history answerable in plain language.
- How a project runs: Map (one working session) → Build (on real data, tested with users) → Run (shipped, monitored, improved).
- Contact: the inquiry form on the homepage (https://asimogg.io/#inquiry) or hello@asimogg.io.

## Real use case (verifiable)
Two research ideas became funded M-ERA.NET projects through a chain of Claude skills (asimo-rd, newton, lens-research, academic writing) and their websites were built with asimo-marketing, asimo-software, security review, impeccable and Higgsfield:
- STF4SW — shear-thickening-fluid seismic dampers; M-ERA.NET 3 Call 2023; 2024–2027; 5 partners; https://www.stf4sw.eu/
- NiPure — isocyanate-free polyurethane thermal-insulation coating; M-ERA.NET Call 2025; €921K total budget; 3 partners; https://nipure.eu/
- Outcome: roughly $250K of public research funding brought to Kalekim, the coordinating enterprise of both consortia, across the 2024 and 2026 rounds. The skill chain wrote the proposals; Kalekim's R&D centre — laboratories, scientific team and coordinator track record — carried equal weight in winning them.
